plurals.name: ui_delete_tag_used_body
plurals.item: “%1$s” is used in %2$d entry. Archive it to keep it on that entry (it only leaves the picker), or delete it from the entry too.
“%1$s” is used in %2$d entries. Archive it to keep it on those entries (it only leaves the picker), or delete it from all of them.
